column1: # Topic-citation fixture verdicts (the former verify-topics guard), read by
# verify-memory.py --selftest. case = fixture directory; the selftest copies it to scratch, drops a trailing
# .in from every file name (MEMORY.md.in keeps fictional citations away from
# verify-links), and passes the copy as the repo root. exit = expected exit
# code. transform = bom-crlf to add a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF endings to
# memory/MEMORY.md and inventory.tsv in the copy, else -. Each case's expected
# stdout is <case>/expected.out (empty for an exit-2 case). stderr = a
# substring stderr must contain (the reason an exit-2 case stopped), else -.
